project: Scenario E — synchronous 200 ms with a one-hour ERP outage (contradictory)
summary: The three constraints cannot all hold. The conflicts are recorded with options; the design stays provisional until the business chooses.

requirements.title: Remain successful while the ERP is unavailable for one hour

openQuestions.title: Does 'success' mean the request is durably accepted, or that the ERP has committed it?

conflicts.title: Synchronous completion vs ERP outage
conflicts.explanation: A synchronous call that completes in the ERP cannot succeed while the ERP is down.
options: Redefine success as durable acceptance (202) and complete asynchronously
Keep synchronous completion and accept failures during outages
Serve from a replicated read model if the call is a read, accepting staleness

conflicts.title: 200 ms completion guarantee vs one-hour outage
conflicts.explanation: No latency guarantee is possible for a completion that depends on an unavailable system.
options: Apply the 200 ms target to acceptance only
Apply it to completion only while the ERP is healthy, with a stated availability target
